tool: Python stdlib barrier + urllib real HTTP (no keep-alive pool)
limits: Burst concurrency is client concurrency, not admitted database concurrency. 429 is reported separately.
Shared isolated MySQL/Redis counters include monitoring and any other clients; not per-request tracing.
Pool metrics sampled after load, not peak utilization.
SQL digest instrumentation may be disabled; zero is not proof of zero queries.
No Kafka worker is required for committed Outbox correctness; delivery is not tested here.
